scripts.sandbox: node dump.js && python3 sandbox/make_run.py data.json > sandbox/run.sh && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/sandbox":/s ubuntu:24.04 bash -c 'apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && apt-get install -y -qq binutils procps file git nmap xxd >/dev/null; bash /s/run.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; cp /results.tsv /s/results.tsv' && python3 sandbox/check_results.py data.json sandbox/results.tsv
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run validate
